columns.name: COMPANYCODE
columns.meaning: Company/legal-entity discriminator -- this schema's tenant key. Appears on 1,934 tables and is the leading primary-key column on most of them. Nearly every query should constrain it, and every join between company-scoped tables should include it.

columns.name: ABSUNIQUEID
columns.meaning: Framework-assigned surrogate row id (BIGINT). Present on most tables. NO foreign key in this schema references it, but it is the target of the implicit FATHERID parent link. Not part of the primary key.
